name: Sturges Orchards and Farm Market
description: Sturges Orchards and Farm Market is a family-run farm in Fombell, PA. It grows Apples, Peaches, Plums, and Cherries, with seasonal availability through autumn and summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Aug – Nov in this growing zone.
